summary: assemble options to filter fragments by regex, choose whether src is on the controller or the remote, set SELinux context parts, and the required src directory.
questions: How do I only assemble files whose names match a pattern?
How do I assemble fragments stored on the control node instead of the target?
How do I set the SELinux type on the assembled file?
Where does assemble look for src by default?

answer_card.title: assemble parameters: src, regexp, remote_src, SELinux
answer_card.answer_md:
- `src` (required): directory of fragments
- `remote_src` (default **true**): src is on the target; set `false` to use the controller
- `regexp`: only include matching filenames (Python regex; escape backslashes for YAML)
- `seuser`, `serole`, `setype`, `selevel`: SELinux context parts (`_default` uses policy)
